    dsimp [N]
    exact Subgroup.normalClosure_normal

    dsimp [N]
    exact Subgroup.subset_normalClosure

    intro M hM hsM
    letI : M.Normal := hM
    dsimp [N]
    exact Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal hsM

    intro M hM
    have hMN : M ≤ N := hM.2.2 N hN hsN
    have hNM : N ≤ M := hleast M hM.1 hM.2.1
    exact le_antisymm hMN hNM
  
  refine ⟨N, ⟨hN, hsN, hleast⟩, ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  exact huniq M hM
